evidence_quotes: Eén of meer verbindingen voor het transport van elektriciteit, waarop meerdere afnemers zijn aangesloten
rationale: The decision of the Dutch Trade and Industry Appeals Tribunal (CBb) concerns an electricity network connection obligation (aansluitplicht) and the qualification of an electricity distribution system on an industrial site as a grid (net) under Articles 1(1)(i) and 23 of the Dutch Electricity Act (Elektriciteitswet / E-wet). It involves electricity transport, not water or sanitation governance.
